objective: Convincing restrained writing movement, preserving the engraving and physical relationships.

nodes.title: Protected illustration
nodes.why: Preserve composition and engraving; static source approved within prior scope.

nodes.title: Generative motion
nodes.why: Investigated image-to-video; camera/texture instability and localized motion limitations. Raw job completion is not artistic approval.

nodes.title: Controlled deformation
nodes.why: Author liked texture and natural moving part; pen folded with fabric and gaze remained unconvincing. Separate rigid prop from deformable material.

nodes.title: Rigid pen + acting
nodes.why: Pen independently keyed, head and ink approximated. Notebook still moved with the hand, requiring semantic separation.

nodes.title: Prepared scene
nodes.why: Fixed environment and notebook, rigid pen, deformable arm, articulated head and progressive ink. Existing hidden surface reconstruction is approximate; not a native Blender render.

nodes.title: Hidden surface readiness
nodes.why: Paper under hand, shirt behind pen and head/sleeve reveals require bound visual review. Intentional Krita/ComfyUI preparation is next; no new animation.

nodes.title: Native Blender motion
nodes.why: Native render parity remains unverified; requires prepared assets before creative test.

provenance: Recovered historical map from MCI08 interim record, MCI07 author review, WH-001 receipt and current gate manifest. Not a complete event-by-event historical trace.
